scope: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12 standard 2–4-player multiplayer, standard scoring two-player Rival, optional base-box CHOAM20; relevant general/Uprising Jan13 2025 FAQ. Ten Ix contracts identified only as an excluded compatibility set. No solo, Rival variants, cross-game expansions, six-player teams or later-product components.
independence_statement: Fresh independent challenger. Read only the explicitly authorized final questions, key, text sources, Shaddam transcription/origin metadata and the two unannotated images. No summary, reader answers, grades, prior reports, conclusions, repair history or Q59 history was inspected. No reader was contacted. Bank/key novelty prose was treated as a claim to challenge, not evidence of completeness. No artifacts other than this JSON report were modified in the repository.

source_key_findings.finding: All102 existing questions and all requested answer parts are supported by the authorized evidence, including source-defined2/3P versus4P reward branches, Rival resource icons, and original Shaddam contract/Signet rules. No substantive key correction identified.

Some older unqualified extraction numeric ranges are stale or ambiguous. Page/section citations generally remain valid, but the two supplied main-rule extractions have different line numbering and some cited ranges match neither. The independent per-question file-qualified locators below replace this ambiguity without changing the key semantics.

rejected_duplicates.reason: Q92 asks legal origins/destinations of an ordinary Agent turn, Q27 explicitly rejects own occupied infiltration, and Q06 requests enemy-occupancy exception. A new named destination changes no rule.

Q49 requests every Sietch option including Hooks conditionality; Q77 directly tests already-owned Hooks idempotency. An isolated human/space retelling adds no distinct outcome or consequential exception beyond that complete branch.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Re-recruit an old garrison troop to evade deployment cap
rejected_duplicates.reason: Q05 directly asks recruited troop origin and deployment cap. FAQ troops reiterates those same restrictions; this would mechanically recombine already requested origin and cap.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: A different number of newly recruited troops or a different resource gain
rejected_duplicates.reason: Existing Q05 and Q100 cover the general rules; changed numbers/resource names create no new source-defined branch.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Additional nonzero marker adjustment via named Staged Incident
rejected_duplicates.reason: Q99 requests strength changes during Combat and using adjusted strength. FAQ Staged Incident is the same marker update with a decrease rather than increase, without a distinct timing exception.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Ordinary Influence gain/loss icon with a different Faction name
rejected_duplicates.reason: Q12/Q37/Q38 cover Faction movement/threshold/loss/eligibility and chosen-Faction rule; changing named track is cosmetic.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Separate Combat marker reset or defensive troop reveal timing question
rejected_duplicates.reason: Q91 explicitly requests both timing procedures, including optionality and origins.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: A second Shaddam branch or reserved-contract setup question
rejected_duplicates.reason: Q102 and Q103 now directly request these original printed branches; Q43/Q93 separately request duration/onset. No missing original Shaddam procedure remains.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Additional Hagal Signet or resource conversion question
rejected_duplicates.reason: Q76 explicitly asks selected Rival-card Signet resolution; Q62 directly asks every homogeneous conversion set and rejects mixed-seven purchase.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Mandate unique Great Houses or one-icon Leaders in setup
rejected_duplicates.reason: M81–85 and M209–212 are story/first-game recommendations, not additional compulsory setup restrictions. Q95 permits chosen/random Leaders and Q21 tests the actual Shaddam exclusion.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Individual named FAQ rulings for original-base/expansion cards not established as Uprising components
rejected_duplicates.reason: Outside authorized component scope unless a general rule or explicitly Uprising-specific clarification. General discard/trash/draw/cost rules and explicitly applicable named rulings are already requested.

rejected_duplicates.candidate: Solo difficulties, Streamlined Rival, expert variants, six-player changes or Ix contract distribution
rejected_duplicates.reason: Explicitly excluded. Only the ten-contract compatibility identification belongs to Q16; not an uncovered standard procedure.
